piece: First real cost experiments over recorded history (Q1 routing, Q2 superlinearity, Q3 C1 revert, Q4 spend breakdown)
next_step: Fresh build critic (rule 22). The two named gaps for whoever takes the next piece: (1) no quality arm anywhere — Q1's $244.41 saving has no G2/G3 measurement beside it; (2) the split ceiling's re-orientation overhead is unmeasured, so $1,728.02 is an upper bound with a missing deduction. re_read_rate over Read calls is the instrument for it and does not exist.

findings.q1_routing: SAVED $244.41, mechanistically attributable. 3,660 Sonnet requests cost $162.94; the identical recorded token flow at Opus prices is $407.34. 3.77% of the counterfactual bill, 60% off the flow it touched. Not confounded: 38 request-count-matched pairs give a median model-independent PIE-tokens-per-request ratio of 1.019, so the cheaper model did not buy back its saving in volume. The naive per-agent comparison (Sonnet $4.29 vs Opus $14.42) is worthless and is published beside it as the wrong answer.
findings.q2_growth: NOT quadratic — exponent 1.268 (R^2 0.876, n=419). The confound is killed and falls the other way: at matched request index long agents are LIGHTER (k=80: 240,931 for 0-99 vs 192,972 for 300+), the work proxy is flat, and the pooled-curve prediction reproduces every bin within 0.96-1.06. Accumulation is 87.1% of context re-read = $4,032.52 = 71.1% of subagent spend. Zero compaction events across 419 agents. Split ceiling at 100-request chunks: $1,728.02 (27.7% of the bill), an UPPER BOUND with no re-orientation modelled.
findings.q3_bursts: C1 REVERT CONFIRMED, reproduced independently. Ceiling 0.291% of spend ($18.13) against C1's own 2% bar; 393/420 agents already warm on their first request; difference +0.17pp with a permutation null of [-5.71,+7.41]pp and p=0.973. Cold-start control fires on the session's first-ever agent (cache_read 0, cache_write 22,925) and the synthetic warm arm proves it refuses to fire when it should not. C1's stated 10pp bar was arithmetically unsatisfiable from a 0.96 base.
findings.q4_attribution: builder 52.6% ($3,266.11) / critic 21.5% ($1,335.74) / unclassified 9.3% / orchestrator 9.0% ($559.15, one thread) / unattributed 2.4% / corpus 2.4% / blog 1.5% / judge 0.9% / plan 0.5%. cache_read is 79.9% of spend. Out of bounds by COST.md §5: critics, judges, plans (22.9% combined). In bounds and ranked: agent lifetime, remaining Sonnet headroom, the orchestrator's own thread.

controls_run: Q1 null control (plausible wrong answer): 33 request-count-matched OPUS agents repriced as Sonnet 'save' $335.03 on work nobody routed — proving the headline measures volume routed, not efficiency.

Q2 null control: a synthetic purely-workload fleet returns exponent 1.79, i.e. the exponent alone cannot discriminate the two mechanisms; the matched-index and accumulation-share tests do, and go red on the workload arm.
Q3 null controls: cold-start control on the first-ever agent (fires), synthetic warm arm (refuses to fire), 4,000-draw label-shuffle permutation preserving burst-size distribution (p=0.973).

Q4 null control: a catch-all 'everything is a builder' classifier reports 91% coverage and distinguishes nothing; the explicit classifier publishes its 11.7% residual instead. Label validity cross-checked by an ordering the labels were not derived from: 41/45 (91.1%) critics start after their item's first builder.
delete-the-fix on the COST.md §4.0 amendment, executed on a copy under the scratchpad: the before/after arms differ, so the control goes red rather than being a second copy of the experiment.
node tools/cost.mjs --self-test and --experiments-self-test both pass; --cost-report --self-test passes 7 arms and 7 controls.
could_not_do: No quality arm. G2/G3 untouched by all four experiments; Q1's saving has no critic-find-rate or verdict-score comparison beside it.
Split ceiling's re-orientation overhead unmeasured; re_read_rate over Read calls does not exist.

E2 (context composition / superseded_share) not run — needs a supersession classifier over tool_use content blocks and a judgement call the plan critic flagged as unresolved (BLOCKING 5). Q2's accumulation decomposition sizes the same lever without it.

Did not re-derive G1. The plan critic's Ruling C (time-integral ~5.4, standing breach) contradicts COST.md Ruling C2 and the ledger's 13.33/13.44; that disagreement is live and belongs to whoever owns the instrument's G1 block.
Three dollar totals in one day span $6,175.91 -> $6,249.75 (1.2%) — source drift as the tree is appended to while parsed, not disagreement. Shares and ratios unaffected.
tools/cost.mjs was silently reverted to an earlier state mid-run by a concurrent write; the experiments module had to be restored from a scratchpad copy and committed immediately. Nothing was lost.
notes: The brief said COST-EXPERIMENTS.md had never been criticised. It has — a full plan-critic section with 7 BLOCKING items at commit b376ac4. Treated as constraints, not authority; every one of its numbers I overlap with was reproduced independently, and we agree.
'The efficiency programme has so far delivered nothing measurable' is now false by $244.41 — small, real, and invisible in C/H for the reasons Q2 gives.
